question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_DATE
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE IS_DELIVERED = TRUE AND ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
),
repeat_customers_h1 AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM delivered_orders
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
repeat_customers_h2 AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM delivered_orders
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeat_customers_h1) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeat_customers_h2) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec

action.answer: In January–June 2025, there were 94,251 repeat customers (customers with at least two delivered orders in that period). In July–December 2025, there were 95,899 repeat customers (evaluated independently for that half). July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025. Population: all customers with at least two delivered orders in each respective half-year period. Unit: unique customers per half-year. Interpretation: The number of repeat customers increased in the second half of 2025.
